decisions.reason: Original 2.1 allowed arbitrary vertex tracks, whose edge boundaries need not be null even for constant maps on an interval. The repair uses tracks a(alpha_v)^(-1)b(alpha_v) on a rooted maximal tree, so each boundary compares images of the same based loop. The K(H,1) higher groups fill the remaining prisms, with AC choosing fillings. Bphi is now constructed with its own tree. Statement and page interface are unchanged. This is a standard missing coherent-tree choice that a competent reader can supply immediately; it is classified nonfatal rather than as a false theorem.

Original 1.1 selected a special c although the claim quantifies over all c; the fibration argument itself works for any prescribed pi1-isomorphism. The repair fixes that arbitrary c, explicitly uses the pi0 fiber action and pi2(BG)=0 to show the fiber is simply connected, and supplies the projective-resolution convention by free modules on successive kernels. H1(F)=0 then forces the H2 edge epimorphism. Statement unchanged.

F2 omitted the stationary-near-both-endpoints hypothesis of the cited extension lemma. The repair restores that hypothesis and its support conclusion. Original 2.1 already constructs a smooth cutoff phi constant near 0 and 1, preserves every strict crossing height difference, and keeps the projection immersive; 3.1 therefore applies the corrected F2 to a compact track in a ball. No mathematical claim or consumer interface changes.

F3 omitted its supplied-resolution premise, although the LHS supplier already uses bar group homology. The repair explicitly supplies free resolutions on successive kernels and discharges DC from AC, so the H1 bar computation is licensed. The N-coinvariant relations are exactly [G,N]/[N,N]. Also added and proved naturality of the complete sequence using functorial bar classifying spaces, mapping-path fibrations, and the natural Serre spectral sequence; this supplies the assigned Stallings consumer without weakening exactness.

Original F1 claimed naturality although the cited Statement supplied only exactness; the compatibility of the transgressions is indispensable in 2.1. The lower-level five-term supplier has now been strengthened and proved natural, and F1 explicitly cites that compatibility. Also supplied the resolution convention for the bar H1 calculation. The induction identifies the kernel layers as cokernels, uses the H2 epimorphism to identify their images under the quotient H2 isomorphism, and lifts elements in the resulting central extensions. Stallings Statement unchanged.

The ring commutator identity in 1.1 is correct, but its first application to Gamma_p and Gamma_q words preceded the degree bounds it needed. The repair keeps 1.1 conditional, proves E(Gamma_q) subset 1+m^q by induction using only p=1 and the previous layer, then applies that proved inclusion to both general inputs. The factorization through Gamma_(d+1), including d=0, follows by multiplicativity. No statement or dependency changes.

The diagram definition uses edges between all crossings, whereas the recursion updates only at underpasses. Without a strand convention or overpass copying, a later edge can retain stale data. The repair explicitly joins edges through every overcrossing into maximal Wirtinger arcs, identifies their compatible meridian symbols, and substitutes that identification into all finite certificates before the existing curl and degree passes. Each nonroot arc is then reached once from its predecessor underpass; overpasses preserve its series. The input scope, arbitrary access and winding corrections, and outputs are preserved.

Original F2 overstated the closed-link presentation theorem as if it covered string links. The proof needs only the local conjugacy lemma, whose Statement explicitly covers both modes, so F2 now separates those scopes and disclaims a string-link presentation input. Reviewed the repaired algorithm interface: arcs are merged through overpasses before certificate substitution. Proof 2.1 now tracks explicit free lift words modulo each lower-central layer, distinguishing closed-link selected lifts from the unique string-link quotient classes. Transport corrections, inverse variable substitution, coefficient indexing and finite gcd computations remain valid; Statement unchanged.

Endpoint collars alone do not fix independently chosen longitude accesses or parallels. Conjugating a longitude with a nonzero linear Magnus term by another meridian can change degree-two coefficients, and changing a parallel winding can change degree one. The repaired Statement requires transport of the full based peripheral datum by the relative ambient extension, exactly as Proof 2.1 already needed. The relative extension fixes the boundary basepoints and connector, hence the end quotient maps commute and unique longitude preimages have equal expansions. Closed-link basing independence and distinct-index self-crossing invariance use the separate supplied lemma and remain unchanged. Adopted the precheck canonical phase order: closed-link isotopy is step 1.2, the independent string-link conclusion is 2.1, and the final link-homotopy step is 3.1.

reviews.reason: The rooted-tree tracks compare images of the same based loops; higher homotopy-prism spheres fill in K(H,1). AC supplies the choices. Statement unchanged; standard omitted coherent choice repaired.

For the prescribed arbitrary c, surjectivity on pi1 gives a connected fiber and pi2(BG)=0 with injectivity on pi1 gives a simply connected fiber. Thus H1(F)=0 and the H2 edge map is onto. Supplied free resolutions discharge the bar convention; Statement unchanged.

The height product vanishes exactly at the finite underpass set. The stationary-ended convex height interpolation preserves strict crossing inequalities and immersion. Corrected F2 now states the endpoint and support hypotheses actually used; Statement unchanged.

Explicit free resolutions and AC discharge the bar supplier premises; conjugation coinvariants are N/[G,N]. Functorial bar maps and natural Serre differentials, edges and filtrations prove the newly stated naturality, including transgression. Its sole direct item consumer, Stallings, was examined next.

The repaired five-term naturality supplies the transgression square used to identify successive-layer cokernels. The H2 epimorphism identifies their images under the quotient H2 isomorphism; kernel/quotient lifting proves the next central-extension isomorphism. Supplied resolutions license H1. Statement unchanged.

The ring identity remains conditional until the Gamma_q degree inclusion is proved by induction. Those bounds then license the general commutator claim, and multiplicativity gives representative-independent truncation, including degree zero. Statement unchanged.

The repaired Definition assigns series to maximal arcs between underpasses/endpoints, with every overpass joining edges into the same arc. Certificate substitution precedes curl transport. Per-degree conjugation, arbitrary transports, finite inverse coordinate iteration and coefficient/gcd output retain their original scope.

Local meridian conjugacy covers both modes, so no string-link presentation is assumed. The proof now follows the repaired maximal-arc convention and explicit free lift words through each quotient. Unique string-link quotient classes and selected closed-link lifts, transport corrections and finite outputs are distinguished correctly. Statement unchanged.

Transported tubes, parallels, meridians and accesses make the relative ambient extension commute with end maps; unique longitude preimages then have equal Magnus expansions. Closed basing independence applies to all indices and self-crossing invariance only to distinct indices. The direct counterexample consumer uses only the unchanged closed-link assertion. Canonical proof phase ordering passes precheck.
